title: Authentication failure is not an authorization failure
problem: A request is rejected and the agent must decide whether the caller was not identified, or was identified and not permitted.
failure: A 401 was read as a permissions problem and the agent requested broader scopes, which could not have helped: the caller had not been identified at all.
correction: Separate the two questions. Who are you (authentication) is answered before what may you do (authorization).
transfer: A rejection carries two distinct causes; widening permissions cannot fix an unidentified caller.
limits: FIXTURE. Test data for tests/retrieval_bilingual_R02.py. A deliberate near-neighbour of fx-authz, present so that a retrieval change which conflates the two is detected rather than rewarded.
